format: single Mr. Rooter plumbing franchise (territory of up to 100,000 population)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Mr. Rooter® franchise ranges from $152,900 to $298,675. This includes $43,750 that must be paid to the franchisor and our affiliates. It does not include fees for additional territory (beyond the minimum 100,000)

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee you must pay to us is $42,500 (the "Minimum Initial Franchise Fee"), which is a fee for a territory of up to 100,000 in population
fee.note: Plus $425 per additional 1,000 population beyond 100,000 (territory generally 100,000 to 300,000). VetFran: 20% off the $42,500; rural franchise (40,000-65,000 population) as low as 50% of the minimum fee; roll-in, multi-unit, additional concept and HIRE discounts cannot go below $42,500. In 2025 the average fee paid was approximately $81,424 (range $39,101 to $320,073). Software System enrollment fee $1,250 also paid to franchisor.

royalty.quote: License Fee 6% of Gross Sales except for special rates that apply to "roll-in" sales. In addition, minimum license fees apply. Tuesday, 5:00 pm Central Time, each week.

adFund.quote: MAP Fee 2% of Gross Sales except for special rates that apply to "roll-in" sales. In addition, minimum MAP fees apply.
adFund.note: Local Marketing Groups: not to exceed 3% of Gross Sales (currently 2% may be required for Neighborly brand initiatives). Initial Marketing Spend Requirement: $60,000 in the first 12 months and $75,000 in months 13-24; franchisor may require Minimum Local Marketing Spending of the greater of $50,000 or 8% of prior-year Gross Sales.

otherRecurring.name: Minimum License Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Greater of 6% or a weekly minimum of $100 to $1,400 depending on territory population and weeks open (Standard: N/A weeks 1-39; e.g. under 150,000 population $100/week weeks 40-78, $200 weeks 79-208, $225 week 209+)

otherRecurring.name: Software System Fees
otherRecurring.amount: $176.45 per month, plus additional email/portal accounts and QuickBooks Online through ZorWare $30-$220 per month

otherRecurring.name: ServiceTitan license (paid to ServiceTitan, Inc.)
otherRecurring.amount: $228-241 per month for each service professional user up to 5 users (lower per-user rates above)

otherRecurring.name: Annual Convention (Reunion) Fees
otherRecurring.amount: Currently up to $1,000, plus travel, lodging, meals and other expenses (mandatory attendance; $2,000 pro-rata if absent)

otherRecurring.name: Initial Marketing Spend Requirement (local marketing)
otherRecurring.amount: $60,000 during the first 12 months and $75,000 during months 13-24

otherRecurring.name: Key Accounts/Management Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to 5% of total Gross Sales related to Key Account work

transferFee.amount: The greater of (i) $15,000 or (ii) 5% of the sales price

headline.label: Average annual Gross Sales, franchised businesses open and reporting the full 52 weeks of 2025

item19.note: Sales only, no costs. 64 (33%) of 193 at or above average. Excludes 22 businesses opened in 2025, 14 transferred in 2025 without full data, 9 reporting $0 Gross Sales, and 13 closed during 2025. Franchisee-reported via the Software System, not GAAP.

special: Royalty (License Fee) is the greater of 6% of weekly Gross Sales or a weekly Minimum License Fee ($100 to $1,400 by territory population and tenure). Mandatory local marketing spend of $60,000 in year 1 and $75,000 in year 2 (and possibly the greater of $50,000 or 8% of Gross Sales thereafter) on top of the 2% MAP Fee. Item 19 median ($1,257,146) is far below the average ($2,093,531): sales are highly skewed.
issues: Item 7 totals line says the low total 'Does not include real estate costs', yet the table includes a Real Estate line ($6,000-$24,000) that is summed into $152,900; excludesRealEstate left null. Software System annual figure computed as $176.45 x 12.
